draft: In this smog-free city, children play without military presence while economic activity thrives without debt or landlord apps. Street vendors sell textiles and produce amidst communal trust and mutual aid societies. The bustling tianguis overflows with goods and services as hydrologist-led workshops teach residents about water management strategies. Despite optimism, tensions arise due to floods and heat waves, prompting discussions on infrastructure resilience and water table dynamics. Community gardens are sustained by volunteers while conversations surround neighborhood co-ops and solar panel installations at schools.
